body.name: Face-complete dual representative
body.construction: \(\mathfrak F^{\star}\) is the finite collection of lower or upper endpoint faces whose relative interior receives positive mass under some \(\pi\in\Pi^{\star}\); \(\Pi^{\mathrm{fc}}\) consists of the priors in \(\Pi^{\star}\) placing positive mass on the relative interior of every member of \(\mathfrak F^{\star}\) with its endpoint sign.
